_doc: Large batch L08 (Sonnet generic pass): family corrections only; colour/lift/snd left to builder defaults.

desert-gila-dragon/f:x0.note: quake slam: ground shock rings out; best guess

desert-gila-dragon/f:u2.note: stomp is a heavy thump, not a streak; keeps tail whip as the only slash

desert-gila-dragon/f:b2.note: beaded scales glint; keeps Bead Hide as the plain shield

desert-gila-dragon/f:u0.note: a chewing bite that works the venom in; poison tag stays mechanical

dune-wyrmling/f:b0.note: stab with thin long fangs: lance; Fang Snap keeps bite

dune-wyrmling/f:u0.note: snap = jaws; pierce tag stays mechanical

dune-wyrmling/f:u2.note: hiss is a breath cloud, not poison drops; frees a drip slot

sand-viper-matriarch/f:b1.note: sidewinding leaves sand waves; best guess

sand-viper-matriarch/f:u3.note: sting is a point-first jab; poison tag stays mechanical, Viper Fang keeps drip

glass-wyrm/f:b2.note: glassy translucent armour glints; Fused Hide keeps the plain shield

glass-wyrm/f:b3.note: sandfling = a flung cloud of sand

glass-wyrm/f:x0.note: waking blow: big thump; Glass Lash is the other bash but only the strongest hit differs

glass-wyrm/f:u1.note: hurled glass shards fly point-first; not electric

spurred-tortoise/f:b3.note: spur dust: kicked-up dust cloud, not poison

spurred-tortoise/f:u1.note: beak spike: keyword beak; pierce stays mechanical, Spur Jab keeps thrust

rock-python/f:b0.note: a snake strike is a bite; Sitter Strike keeps the lance

rock-python/f:b3.note: non-venomous hiss over sun-warm rock: heat shimmer, not drops

grass-snake/f:b1.note: reed whip: reed lash, closest leaf; best guess

grass-snake/f:b2.note: green scale coil among grass blades; Coil keeps the shield

grass-snake/f:u1.note: a lunging strike goes point-first; shock (electric) does not fit a snake

grass-snake/f:u2.note: constrict + trip: wrap strands; best guess

emerald-python/f:b2.note: emerald scale mail glints; Emerald Coil keeps the shield

emerald-python/f:b3.note: hiss mist spray: a mist puff

emerald-python/f:u0.note: squeeze + trip: coil binding strands; best guess
